D: A journalist investigates a cursed videotape that kills whoever watches it seven days later.
P: Serve the snacks when Rachel puts the tape in the player at the mountain cabin.
S: cabin 12 at the mountain lodge where the tape was found
Smoked trout, crackers, sharp cheddar, apple slices and pickled onions on a wooden board, the way a lodge would set it out.

Thick New England clam chowder of fresh clams, smoky bacon, potato and cream, served in small cups with crackers and snipped chives. Steam 1kg vongole in 200ml water in a covered pot for 4 minutes until open, then pick out the meat and strain the liquid. Fry 150g diced bacon, add 1 diced onion and 2 diced celery sticks and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then the clam liquid, 300ml milk and 400g diced potato. Simmer for 15 minutes until the potato is tender, add 200ml cream and the clams and warm through. Season with pepper and serve with crackers and chives.
Cucumbers sliced thin, packed with dill, garlic and peppercorns in a hot vinegar brine, left in the fridge for seven days before eating.
M: the ferry to the island with the horse farm
Salmon fillets brushed with miso, honey and soy, roasted at 220C for 8 minutes, with wild rice and charred broccolini.
Moesko Island beef and dark ale stew
the Morgans' horse farm on Moesko Island

Chuck steak braised low with dark ale, pearl barley, carrot and onion until spoon-soft, with crusty bread and a sharp horseradish cream. Toss 1.2kg diced chuck steak in 2 tbsp seasoned flour and brown in batches in oil. Add 2 sliced onions and 3 chunky carrots and cook for 5 minutes. Pour in 375ml dark ale and 500ml beef stock, add 80g pearl barley, 2 bay leaves and thyme, cover and cook at 160C for 2.5 hours until tender. Stir 2 tbsp grated horseradish into 150ml sour cream with a pinch of salt. Serve the stew with crusty bread and the horseradish cream.
W: the well at the bottom of everything
Dark chocolate custard of cream, milk, yolks and sugar, poured into deep cups, baked in a water bath at 150C for 30 minutes, chilled, a ring of whipped cream on top.
K: cabin 12 at the Shelter Mountain Inn
Whisky, honey, lemon and hot water with a cinnamon stick, for a wet Seattle night.

s.note: cabin 12 at the mountain lodge where the tape was found
s.how: Flake 150g hot-smoked trout onto a wooden board. Add crackers, 200g sharp cheddar, a sliced apple and pickled onions, the way a mountain lodge would set it out.

Slice 500g small cucumbers thin and pack into a jar with dill, 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp peppercorns. Pour over 250ml hot white vinegar boiled with 250ml water, 2 tbsp sugar and 1 tbsp salt. Refrigerate seven days before eating.

m.note: the ferry to the island with the horse farm
m.how: Mix 2 tbsp white miso, 1 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp soy and brush over 4 salmon fillets. Roast at 220C for 8 minutes. Cook 250g wild rice. Char 2 bunches broccolini in a hot pan.

w.note: the well at the bottom of everything
w.how: Warm 300ml cream and 200ml milk, pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate and stir smooth. Whisk 4 yolks with 60g sugar and combine. Pour into 4 deep cups and bake in a water bath at 150C for 30 minutes. Chill and pipe a ring of cream.

d.note: cabin 12 at the Shelter Mountain Inn
d.how: Put 1 tbsp honey, the juice of a quarter lemon and 40ml whisky in each of 4 mugs. Top with 150ml boiling water, stir and add a cinnamon stick.
